name: R009-gengar-skill-swap-roll
why: Challenge 5 (full AI). The opponent leads Gengar (set 613: Psychic, Thunderbolt, Giga Drain, Skill Swap; Levitate, not in the list). The player leads Shiftry (set 590: Chlorophyll or Early Bird; Grass/Dark, so Psychic has no effect and Thunderbolt / Giga Drain are resisted) and stalls with Sunny Day and Synthesis. Every AI turn AI_CV_ChangeSelfAbility guesses Shiftry's ability (Random & 1); a guessed Chlorophyll reaches the <50 roll of AI_CV_ChangeSelfAbility3 (about 20 percent), whose jump is the runCvChangeSelfAbility '? 0' branch. When Shiftry's real ability is Early Bird, Gengar's Skill Swaps only trade Early Bird / Levitate, so the guess and roll repeat every turn (about 10 percent a turn); when it is Chlorophyll, Gengar takes it with its first unrolled Skill Swap and the window closes. Then Houndoom 618 (Early Bird / Flash Fire; its Double-Edge cannot touch Gengar) and Ludicolo 592 (Swift Swim / Rain Dish, both in the list; Double Team) give more turns. Alakazam 596 (Skill Swap) is the opponent's second Pokemon.
